info.name: WebServices Assignment1 API
info.description:
Collection for the FastAPI + MongoDB Atlas product service.  
Covers all endpoints with a full end-to-end workflow:  
POST /addnew → GET /getSingleProduct → GET /getAll → GET /startsWith →  
GET /paginate → GET /convert → DELETE /products → verify deletion.

NOTE: The route decorator in main.py contains a typo:  
@app.get("/getSingleProduct/{ProductID: str}")  
FastAPI registers this as the literal path "/getSingleProduct/{ProductID: str}".  
The collection uses the corrected URL "/getSingleProduct/{{productId}}" which  
matches the intended behaviour once the typo is fixed in the source code.
